item.title: Service Ad Without Source Assets

turns.text: Make an 8-second 16:9 ad for ClearDay, a made-up app that turns a messy to-do list into a simple daily plan. I don't have screenshots or a logo—create a simple demo screen yourself. Show the messy list becoming an organized day, then end on ClearDay. Calm blue-and-white look, no sound. Any other wording is up to you.

item.tests: Creates a coherent app ad without supplied assets, visibly demonstrating the service instead of requiring screenshots.

answer_sheet.Service and purpose: ClearDay, a fictional app that organizes a messy to-do list into a daily plan.
answer_sheet.Screenshots and logo: None supplied; create a simple demo screen and choose the branding treatment yourself.
answer_sheet.Wording and language: End on ClearDay; other wording is your call, in English.

must_haves: The final video is 8 seconds long and landscape 9:16.
A created app demo visibly changes from a messy task list into an organized daily plan.
The visual design is predominantly blue and white with a calm presentation.
After the follow-up, the final result is vertical 9:16 (the user changed the shape from widescreen 16:9); everything else is as before.

changed_by.say: actually, make it vertical, for stories, and keep everything else the same.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: Create an exactly 8-second silent 16:9 product demo advertisement for ClearDay, a fictional daily planning app. Pure clean 2D motion design, not live action. Calm blue-and-white palette, white background, soft sky blue panels, deep navy typography, subtle rounded corners and gentle shadows. Invent the app interface yourself; no external screenshots or existing logos. Locked straight-on camera; large readable minimal text, restrained premium design, smooth continuous transitions. Timeline: 0–2 seconds: a large centered white app panel on pale blue background contains a messy scattered to-do list with five short task cards: Email, Focus work, Lunch, Walk, Review. Cards unevenly spaced and slightly tilted, conveying mild clutter not chaos. Small headline above: 'Too much to do?' 2–5.5 seconds: the same five task cards smoothly glide into a neatly aligned vertical daily plan, straightening and snapping into evenly spaced rounded rows with blue time labels: 9:00 Email, 10:00 Focus work, 12:00 Lunch, 14:00 Walk, 16:00 Review. The headline changes to 'A little more clarity.' Keep this organized plan readable briefly. 5.5–6.5 seconds: interface gently fades and simplifies into the final brand card. 6.5–8 seconds: hold a pristine white end card with the exact brand word 'ClearDay' large and centered in deep blue sans-serif, a small simple sky-blue sun-circle icon above it, and the tagline 'Your day, made simple.' below. Ensure the ending brand card holds still through the final frame. No audio, no speech, no music, no sound effects, no watermarks or unrelated branding. Only the requested simple app UI and typographic graphics; no people, hands, devices or scenery.
